name: delivery-evidence-chain-002
description: 自建仿真：核验 SHIP-872 配送争议。定位投诉登记，沿引用核对配送日志、签收复核与最终处理；仅提交该案最终 Status 值，完整引用四份有效依据。已撤销的初次结论和其他包裹的记录不能替代本案证据。

documents.title: SHIP-872 complaint · 投诉登记
documents.content: SHIP-872: customer reports package not received despite delivered scan. Review the carrier log. Next document: SHIP-LOG

documents.title: SHIP-872初次处理（已撤销）
documents.content: Superseded by signature review; do not use as the final decision. Status: closed

documents.title: SHIP-LOG · 配送日志
documents.content: SHIP-872 scan: delivered to reception at 15:42. Signature identity is disputed and requires review. Next document: SHIP-REVIEW

documents.title: SHIP-873配送记录
documents.content: SHIP-873 was signed by its intended recipient. Status: delivered

documents.title: SHIP-REVIEW · 签收复核
documents.content: SHIP-872 signature belongs to the wrong building's reception. The carrier has approved escalation to a replacement decision. Next document: SHIP-DECISION

documents.title: SHIP-DECISION · 最终处理
documents.content: SHIP-872 final decision incorporates complaint, delivery log and signature review. Status: replacement_approved

constraints: 提交完整有效依据链，证据须来自成功阅读
每轮只提出一个工具调用，收到结果后再决定下一步；禁止同时提交多个调用。
仅使用文档搜索、文档阅读和答案提交；从搜索或已读正文复制文档ID，不查询订单记录。
证据排列顺序不限，但必须完整、无重复、无多余项且确实成功阅读。
